My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder, and your high places…
Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all…
You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
For Yahweh says, “You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.”
“Now therefore, what do I do here,” says Yahweh, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over…

translations.web: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.
translations.bsb: Your wealth and your treasures I will give up as plunder, without charge for all your sins within all your borders.
translations.kjv: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
translations.asv: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give for a spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
